set.scroll.hint: Ipedi lokuthinta: swayiphela ngeminwe emibili ukuze uzungeze, bamba i-Shift uswayiphele ukuze ushelelise, cwecwa ukuze usondeze — akudingeki zinkinobho zekhamera. Ividili lesikrolu: ividili lisondeza. "Bala ngokuzenzakalelayo" kuthatha ukuskrola okuhlanganayo noma okuncane njengepedi lokuthinta.
set.touch2.hint: Iminwe emibili futhi icwecwe ukusondeza; iminwe emithathu yenza enye into. Bamba umunwe owodwa ungashukumi endaweni engenalutho, bese uhudula, ukuze uzungeze ngomunwe owodwa. Lapho udweba, i-loupe ephezulu komunwe wakho ikhombisa amaphoyinti ebambelela kuwo.
set.snap.hint: Kokubili futhi kuyizinkinobho ngaphansi kwesokudla esiphansi sokubuka, ukuze uzivale kuhambo olulodwa bese uzibuyisela.
set.corner.hint: Ikhyubhu lokubuka lihlala ngaphezulu kwesokudla kokubuka: chofoza ubuso, imphetho noma ikhona ukuze ubuke kusuka lapho, hudula ukuze uzungeze, hudula indandatho yekhampasi ukuze uphendule imodeli. Isithonjana se-axis iwumaki omncane we-X, Y, Z ngaphansi kwesobunxele.
set.nav.hint: Uma kuvuliwe: ukuzungeza kujikela phakathi kwephoyinti lemodeli elingaphansi kwesikhombi, nokushelelisa kugcina leliphoyinti libheke isikhombi; endaweni engenalutho zombili zisebenzisa phakathi kwesikhala sokubuka. Uma kuvaliwe: njalo phakathi. Bamba i-Shift uzungeze ukuze ushelelise, uyeke ukuze uzungeze futhi. Izivinini zisebenza kwemouse, ipedi lokuthinta, ukuthinta nezinkinobho zokuhamba.
set.printbed.hint: Hlola ukuprinta nge-3D itshela uma imodeli inkulu kulena. Khetha usayizi oseduze kakhulu nevolumu yokwakha yomshini wakho.
set.newmodels.hint: Amamodeli amasha (Okusha, nekhasi lapho livula) aqala ngamayunithi, isitayela sokubonisa nendawo yemodeli evulwe manje. Kugcinwa kulesi siphequluli kuphela; ifayela ligcina lokalo.
set.tour.hint: Izinyathelo ezine ezimfushane: unxande, ibhokisi, iqembu, nokuhlolwa kokuprinta nge-3D. Liqala lodwa okokuqala kuphela.

app.print3d.w.touch.other: Izingxenye zihlangana ubuso nobuso ngamaphethelo: {n}. Ama-slicer ngokuvamile ayazihlanganisa.

app.print3d.w.tiny: Ingaphansi kwe-1 mm ngobubanzi. Hlola iyunithi yemodeli.
app.print3d.w.nobase: Akukho okulala phansi: phendula imodeli ukuze uhlangothi lumise esisekelweni, noma i-slicer izodinga izisekelo noma i-raft.
app.print3d.w.overhang: Ukuhlezela kumadigri ngaphezu kwalokhu: {angle}°. {share}% wobuso buyahlezela futhi buzodinga ukusekelwa.
app.print3d.w.unchecked: Imodeli inkulu kakhulu ukuze ihlolwe ngokugcwele ukuthi izingxenye azidluli ngokwazo.
app.print3d.fixhint: Ukuze uthole izinkinga eqenjini noma ekhomponentini, khetha lokho, bese usebenzisa Bonisa izinkinga kanye Lungisa kumininingwane yento.

app.prep.verdict.look.one: Ilungele ukuphrinta, kodwa kukhona {n} into okufanele uyibheke kuqala.
app.prep.verdict.look.other: Ilungele ukuphrinta, kodwa kukhona {n} izinto ezifanele ukubhekwa kuqala.

app.prep.nothing: Akukho okungalungiswa ngokuzenzakalelayo: bona okufanele ukwenze kwinkinga ngayinye.
app.prep.bed.none: Asikho isisekelo sesiprinta esikhethiwe, ngakho usayizi awuhlolwa (Izilungiselelo › ModelCraft).
app.prep.todo.empty: Bonisa izingxenye ofuna ukuziphrinta, noma uzikhethe, bese uhlola futhi.
app.prep.why.open: Isiprinta sidinga isimo esivaliwe ukuze sazi okungaphakathi. Uma kukhona isikhala, i-slicer iyaqagela noma iyenqaba.
app.prep.todo.open: Lungisa okungalungiswa ukuvala izikhala ezilingene. Uma kungenjalo, dweba uhlangothi olungekho.
app.prep.why.nonmanifold: Lapho izinhlangothi ezintathu zabelana ngephethelo elilodwa, i-slicer ayikwazi ukuhlukanisa ngaphakathi nangaphandle.
app.prep.todo.nonmanifold: Lungisa okungalungiswa kususa izinhlangothi ezisemaphakathi emumo. Uma kungenjalo, susa uhlangothi olweqile.
app.prep.why.flipped: Uhlangothi obheke ngaphakathi buholela i-slicer ekufundeni lolo hlangothi njengelingenalutho.
app.prep.todo.flipped: Lungisa okungalungiswa kuphendula lezo zinhlangothi ngendlela efanele.
app.prep.why.inverted: Ingxenye ephendukile ifundeka njengendawo engenalutho: iphrintwa njengento engenalutho, noma igaxa okuzungezile.
app.prep.todo.inverted: Lungisa okungalungiswa kuphendulela ingxenye ngendlela efanele.
app.prep.why.selfintersect: Lapho ingxenye igoba ngokwayo, i-slicer ayikwazi ukutshela ukuthi uhlangothi luqinile.
app.prep.todo.selfintersect: Khetha ingxenye, sebenzisa Hlela › More › Intersect with model, bese usula okungaphakathi.
app.prep.why.overlap: Izingxenye ezihlangene ziphrintwa njengecwecwe elilodwa, okuvamise ukuba yilokho ofuna kona.
app.prep.why.touch: Izingxenye ezihlangana kuphela zingaphrintwa zihlanganile, noma zihlukane.
app.prep.why.tiny: Imodeli edwetshwe ngeyunithi engafanele iphrintwa incane kakhulu.
app.prep.todo.tiny: Hlola iyunithi kubha yesimo, bese ukhulisa imodeli.
app.prep.why.bed: Ayikwazi ukulingana nesisekelo sesiprinta esikhethwe Ezilungiselelweni.
app.prep.todo.bed: Yehlisa usayizi wayo, phendula, noma uyinqume ibe yizingxenye.
app.prep.why.nobase: Ukuphrinta kudinga uhlangothi oluthe tshe esisekelweni ukuze kuhlale kahle kuze kwakhiwe.
app.prep.todo.nobase: Phendula imodeli ukuze uhlangothi oluthe tshe lube phansi, noma vumela i-slicer ingeze izisekelo.
app.prep.why.overhang: Isiprinta sakha ngezendlalelo kusuka phansi kuya phezulu, futhi isendlalelo asikwazi ukuhlezela emoyeni.
app.prep.todo.overhang: Phendula imodeli ukuze kuhlezele kancane, noma vumela i-slicer ingeze izisekelo.
app.prep.why.unchecked: Imodeli enkulu kakhulu ihlolwa ngengxenye kuphela ukuze kubonakale ukuthi idlula ngokwayo.
app.guide.title: Imodeli yakho yokuqala
app.guide.face.body: Cindezela {key} noma khetha ithuluzi, chofoza ikhoneni elilodwa phansi, bese ikhoneni elicaphune nalo. Noma chofoza ikhoneni elilodwa, thayipha {eg} bese ucindezela {enter}.
app.guide.solid.body: Cindezela {key} noma khetha ithuluzi, chofoza unxande, nyakazisela phezulu bese uchofoza. Noma thayipha ukuphakama njengo {eg} bese ucindezela {enter}.
app.guide.group.body: Khetha ibhokisi lonke, bese ucindezela {key} ukuze ulenze iqembu. Iqembuligcina ubuso balo ndawonye, ngakho linyakaza njengoyodwa futhi akukho okudwetshwa eduze kwalo okunamathela kulo.
app.guide.print.body: Chofoza Hlola manje (noma Export › Check for 3D printing). Uma kuthi Ilungele ukuphrinta, dawuniloda ifayela le-3MF noma le-STL ze-slicer yesiprinta yakho.
app.guide.done.body: Okulandelayo, dweba ohlangothini lwebhokisi ukuze wengeze imininingwane, faka okuthile kusuka ku-Starter library, noma cindezela F1 ukuze uthole usizo.
app.import.site.empty: {file} alinayo imigqa, ama-arc noma izindilinga endaweni yemodeli yokungenisa.
app.import.site.group: Konke kuqembu: hlukanisa ukuze udwebe kuwo ngqo.
app.unsaved.text: Le modeli inezinguquko ezingalondolozwanga. Ingabe kufanele kuqala kulondolozwe ikhophi?
app.handoff.gone: Ifayela elidluliswe kusuka kolunye uhlelo lusephelelwe yisikhathi noma livulwe ngaphambili.Liphinde lithunyelwe.
app.drop.mesh: {name} ifike kusuka kolunye uhlelo njengeqembu endaweni yomsuka womodeli. Ctrl+Z iyihlehlisa.
app.handoff.failed: Ifayela elidluliswe kusuka kolunye uhlelo alikwazanga ukufundwa kusitoreji salesi sisuki.
m3d.tool.click_to_select_drag_left_to: Chofoza ukuze ukhethe. Hudula kusuka kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla ukuze ukhethe ngewindi, kusuka kwesokudla kuya kwesobunxele ukuze ukhethe ngokuqhathanisa. Chofoza kabili iqembu ukuze uvule.
m3d.tool.click_the_end_of_the_line: Chofoza ukuphela komugqa, noma bhala ubude. Esc iyima.
m3d.tool.click_the_opposite_corner_or_ty: Chofoza ikhona elingaphambili, noma bhala ububanzi, ukuphakama (isb. 4m,3m).
m3d.tool.click_the_first_corner_on_the: Chofoza ikhona lokuqala — phansi noma kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi.
m3d.tool.rect_plane_red: Irektangeli ikhiyiwe kule pulani ebomvu (ime ngqo, ilingane nebomvu). Cindezela okhiye ofanayo ukuze uyikhiphe.
m3d.tool.rect_plane_green: Irektangeli ikhiyiwe kule pulani eluhlaza (ime ngqo, ilingane neluhlaza). Cindezela okhiye ofanayo ukuze uyikhiphe.
m3d.tool.rect_plane_blue: Irektangeli ikhiyiwe kule pulani eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka (ilingile). Cindezela okhiye ofanayo ukuze uyikhiphe.
m3d.tool.click_to_set_the_radius_or: Chofoza ukusetha umsantsa, noma uwubhale. Bhala 12s ukuze uthole izinhlangothi ezingu-12.
m3d.tool.click_the_start_of_the_arc: Chofoza isiqalo somnsalo — phansi noma kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi.
m3d.tool.click_the_end_of_the_arc: Chofoza ukuphela komnsalo, noma bhala ubude besitshalo sawo.
m3d.tool.move_to_bulge_the_arc_click: Hambisa ukuze wenze umnsalo ugobe, chofoza, noma bhala ukugoba. Bhala 12s ukuze uthole izingxenye ezingu-12.
m3d.tool.click_the_center_of_the_arc: Chofoza isikhungo somnsalo — phansi noma kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi.
m3d.tool.click_where_the_arc_starts_or: Chofoza lapho umnsalo uqala, noma bhala umsantsa.
m3d.tool.click_where_the_arc_ends_or: Chofoza lapho umnsalo uphela, noma bhala i-engeli ngamadigri.
m3d.tool.click_where_this_point_goes_or: Chofoza lapho leli phoyinti liya khona, noma bhala <dx,dy,dz>. Esc iyibuyisela.
m3d.tool.click_a_square_to_move_that: Chofoza isikwele ukuze uhambise leli phoyinti lejika. Esc iphetha.
m3d.tool.click_the_next_point_enter_or: Chofoza iphoyinti elilandelayo. Faka noma chofoza kabili ukuqeda; chofoza iphoyinti lokuqala ukuze uyivale; Backspace ibuyisela emuva iphoyinti lokugcina.
m3d.tool.click_the_face_to_sweep_along: Chofoza uhlangothi okuzoshayelwa phezu kwalo ngomzila okhethiwe.
m3d.tool.click_the_face_to_sweep_then: Chofoza uhlangothi okuzoshayelwa, bese umphetho womzila — noma khetha umzila kuqala.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_to_offset_its: Chofoza uhlangothi ukuze ushintshele imiphetho yalo, noma khetha imiphetho kuqala. Chofoza kabili uhlangothi ukuze uphinde ibanga lokugcina.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_group_or_component: Chofoza uhlangothi, iqembu noma ingxenye ukuze uyipende. Ctrl: izinhlangothi ezixhunyiwe zalowo mbala · Shift: zonke izinhlangothi zalowo mbala · Alt: thatha umbala.
m3d.tool.move_to_push_or_pull_click: Hambisa ukuze uphushe noma udonse, chofoza ukuqeda, noma bhala ibanga.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_to_push_or: Chofoza uhlangothi ukuze uluphushe noma uludonse. Chofoza kabili uhlangothi ukuze uphinde ibanga lokugcina.
m3d.tool.click_a_point_to_move_from: Chofoza iphoyinti lokuqala lokuhambisa (khetha kuqala, noma into ephansi kwesikhombisi izohamba). Ctrl ikopisha.
m3d.tool.copied_type_3x_for_more_copies: Kukopishiwe. Bhala 3x ukuze uthole izikhopi eziningi ngokulandelana, noma /3 ukuhlukanisa ibanga.
m3d.tool.click_the_centre_of_rotation_on: Chofoza isikhungo sokuzungeza (phezu kohlangothi ukuze uzungeze endizeni yalo; izinkinobho zesikhombisi zikhetha i-akisi).
m3d.tool.click_a_point_to_start_the: Chofoza iphoyinti lapho kuqala khona i-engeli.
m3d.tool.click_to_set_the_angle_or: Chofoza ukusetha i-engeli, noma bhala amadigri.
m3d.tool.rotate_copy_on: Kukopishwa: okokuqala kuyahlala. Ctrl izungeza kunalokho.
m3d.tool.rotated_copy_type_3x: Kukopishiwe. Bhala 3x ukuze uthole izikhopi eziningi zizungeze isikhungo, noma /3 ukuhlukanisa i-engeli.
m3d.tool.move_to_turn_click_to_finish: Hambisa ukuze uphendule, chofoza ukuqeda, noma bhala amadigri. X, Y noma Z zikhetha i-akisi.
m3d.tool.move_to_resize_click_to_finish: Hambisa ukuze ushintshe usayizi, chofoza ukuqeda; noma bhala isilinganiso (2), noma esisodwa ngasinye ene-akisi (2,1,0.5 bomvu, oluhlaza, okwesibhakabhaka).
m3d.tool.drag_or_click_a_grip_on: Hudula noma chofoza isibambi ebhokisini: ikhona likhula ngokulinganayo, umphetho noma uhlangothi kuyelula (Ctrl: ngokuzungeze isikhungo). Noma chofoza iphoyinti elihlala lisendaweni.
m3d.tool.move_away_from_the_centre_to: Hambisa ukuze uye ngaphandle kwesikhungo ukuze ukhule, uye kuso ukuze wehle; chofoza ukuqeda, noma bhala isilinganiso.
m3d.tool.click_an_edge_a_group_a: Chofoza umphetho, iqembu, isiqondiso noma isilinganiso ukuze useze, noma hudula phezu kwezinhlobo eziningi. Izinhlangothi ziyahamba nemiphetho yazo.
m3d.tool.move_off_the_edge_and_click: Hamba ngaphandle komphetho bese uchofoza ukubeka umugqa wesiqondisi ofanayo, noma bhala ukushintshwa.
m3d.tool.click_to_measure_and_drop_a: Chofoza ukulinganisa nokubeka iphoyinti lesiqondisi, noma bhala ibanga.
m3d.tool.click_an_edge_to_start_a: Chofoza umphetho ukuze uqale umugqa wesiqondisi ofana nawo, noma iphoyinti lokulinganisa kuso.
m3d.tool.click_the_center_of_the_protrac: Chofoza isikhungo se-protractor — uma kuhlangothi, ilele kuleyo hlangothi.
m3d.tool.click_a_point_for_0_arrow: Chofoza iphoyinti lika-0° (okhiye bemicibisholo: beka i-protractor ilingane nebomvu, oluhlaza noma okwesibhakabhaka).
m3d.tool.move_to_the_angle_15_steps: Hambisa uye ku-engeli (izinyathelo ze-15° ziyabambeka) bese uchofoza, noma bhala i-engeli ngamadigri.
m3d.tool.move_to_place_the_dimension_lin: Hambisa ukuze ubeke umugqa wesilinganiso bese uchofoza, noma bhala ukushintshwa kwawo.
m3d.tool.drag_to_orbit_middle_drag_orbit: Hudula ukuze uzungeze; bamba Shift ukuze ushelelise. Ukuhudula kwephakathi kuzungeza nganoma yiliphi ithuluzi.
m3d.tool.drag_to_pan_shift_middle_drag: Hudula ukuze ushelelise. Shift + ukuhudula kwephakathi kushelelisa nganoma yiliphi ithuluzi.
m3d.tool.drag_up_and_down_to_zoom: Hudula phezulu nasezansi ukuze usondeze. Ivili lesikrolo lisondeza nganoma yiliphi ithuluzi.
m3d.tool.click_where_the_component_goes_: Chofoza lapho ingxenye iya khona (imvelaphi yayo ifika lapho).
m3d.tool.click_where_the_pasted_copy_goe: Chofoza lapho ikhophi enamathisiwe iya khona (ikhona layo elisezansi lifika lapho). Esc iyakhansela.
m3d.tool.this_curve_can_no_longer_be: Leli jika alisaguquleki (lelithe lelulwa noma lahlukaniswa); liphinde lidwebe.
m3d.tool.click_two_points_or_more_for: Chofoza amaphoyinti amabili noma ngaphezulu ukuze uthole ijika.
m3d.tool.that_edge_is_part_of_the: Lo mphetho uyingxenye yohlangothi: chofoza umphetho womzila.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_inside_the_open_2: Chofoza uhlangothi (ngaphakathi kweqembu elivuliwe), noma khetha imiphetho kuqala.
m3d.tool.push_pull_works_on_a_face: Ukuphusha/ukudonsa kusebenza phezu kohlangothi. Chofoza uhlangothi.
m3d.tool.select_something_to_move_first_: Khetha okuthile ukuze uhambise kuqala, noma chofoza kukho.
m3d.tool.select_something_to_rotate_firs: Khetha okuthile ukuze uzungeze kuqala, noma chofoza kukho.
m3d.tool.select_something_to_scale_first: Khetha okuthile ukuze ulinganise usayizi kuqala, noma chofoza kukho.
m3d.tool.type_a_factor_above_0_2: Bhala isilinganiso esiphezu kwe-0 (2), noma esintathu: bomvu, oluhlaza, okwesibhakabhaka (2,1,0.5).
m3d.tool.type_a_factor_above_0_such: Bhala isilinganiso esiphezu kwe-0, njengo-2 noma 0.5.
m3d.tool.move_off_the_edge_first_to: Hamba ngaphandle komphetho kuqala ukuze ukhombise uhlangothi.
m3d.tool.move_the_pointer_first_to_show: Hambisa isibonisi kuqala ukuze ukhombise uhlangothi lapho isilinganiso siya khona.
m3d.tool.circle_center: Chofoza isikhungo — phansi noma kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi. Bhala {eg}s ukushintsha izinhlangothi (manje: {n}).
m3d.tool.curve_done: Ijika elidlula kumaphoyinti: {n}. Khetha bese uchofoza Hlela amaphoyinti ku-Ulwazi lwento ukuze uyishintshe.
m3d.tool.curve_done_closed: Ijika elivaliwe elidlula kumaphoyinti: {n}. Khetha bese uchofoza Hlela amaphoyinti ku-Ulwazi lwento ukuze uyishintshe.

m3d.tool.follow_ring.one: Kushayelwe phezu komphetho: {n}. Izinhlangothi ezintsha: {faces}, indandatho evaliwe.
m3d.tool.follow_ring.other: Kushayelwe phezu kwemiphetho: {n}. Izinhlangothi ezintsha: {faces}, indandatho evaliwe.

m3d.tool.stopped_at: Kumile lapho ithinta khona, ibanga: {d}. Vala Ukuhlangana (phansi kwesokudla) ukuze udlule.
m3d.tool.move_where: Chofoza lapho iya khona, noma bhala ibanga. Ctrl yenza ikhophi.
m3d.tool.move_where_copy: Chofoza lapho iya khona, noma bhala ibanga. Ctrl ihambisa kunalokho.
m3d.tool.stopped_after: Kumile lapho ithinta khona, emva kwebanga: {d}. Vala Ukuhlangana (phansi kwesokudla) ukuze udlule.
m3d.tool.dim_start: Chofoza ikhona lokulinganisa kuso, noma umphetho (emsalweni noma endilingeni: umsantsa wayo noma ububanzi obuphindwe kabili).
m3d.tool.dim_start_resize: Chofoza ikhona noma umphetho ukuze ulinganise, noma bhala ubude ukuze ulungise okulinganiswe ngokuqondile.
m3d.model.a_face_would_shrink_to_nothing: uhlangothi lungancipha lube lutho noma luphenduke ngaphakathi
m3d.model.a_face_would_bend_out_of: uhlangothi lungagoba luphume endizeni yalo; linganisa ngomphetho, noma ngebomvu, oluhlaza noma okwesibhakabhaka
m3d.model.this_curve_bounds_a_face_that: Leli jika libopha uhlangothi oluphuma endizeni yalo (lusundulwe noma ludonswe): umsantsa wawo awukwazi ukushintsha manje.
m3d.model.a_curve_needs_two_points_or: Ijika lidinga amaphoyinti amabili noma ngaphezulu.
m3d.model.this_curve_can_no_longer_be: Leli jika alisaguquleki (lelithe lelulwa noma lahlukaniswa); liphinde lidwebe.
m3d.model.this_curve_bounds_a_face_erase: Leli jika libopha uhlangothi: susa kuqala uhlangothi, noma dweba ijika elisha.
m3d.model.choose_a_path_one_or_more: Khetha umzila: umphetho owodwa noma ngaphezulu oxhunyiwe.
m3d.model.the_path_branches_select_one_c: Umzila uyahlukana: khetha ishini elilodwa lemiphetho, ngaphandle kwezahlukaniso.
m3d.model.the_path_is_in_more_than: Umzila usesiqeshini ngaphezu kwesisodwa: khetha ishini elilodwa elixhunyiwe lemiphetho.
m3d.model.the_face_lies_along_the_path: Uhlangothi lulele umzila: luphendule ukuze udlule umzila (Landela mina iyashayela ngokuma phezu kwawo).
m3d.model.bad_image: Leso sithombe ayikwazi ukugcinwa: kuphela izithombe ze-PNG, JPEG nezi-WebP ezingaphansi kuka-18 MB.
m3d.model.bad_light: Lokho kukhanya akukwazi ukugcinwa: kudinga uhlobo nendawo.
m3d.tool.light_where: Chofoza lapho {kind} iya khona: ezingqeni noma odongeni ihlala ngaphandle kohlangothi kancane.
m3d.model.that_is_further_than_this_face: Lokho kudlula lolu hlangothi: uhlangothi luzophenduka ngaphakathi.
Lokho kudlula lolu hlangothi: isakhiwo esisha sizophambanisa sona.
m3d.model.offset_works_on_one_chain_of: Ukushintshela kusebenza ishini elilodwa lemiphetho: lezi zihlukana.
m3d.model.offset_works_on_one_connected_: Ukushintshela kusebenza ishini elilodwa elixhunyiwe lemiphetho.
m3d.model.that_is_further_than_these_edg: Lokho kudlula lemiphetho: ingxenye izophenduka ngaphakathi.
m3d.model.the_end_that_moves_is_not: iphetho elinyakazayo alilona ikhona lemodeli; khetha ukuthi yiliphi iphetho elihambayo ku-Ulwazi lwento
m3d.tool.divide_pick: Chofoza umphetho noma ijika ukuze uluhlukanise (noma khetha lolo kuqala), noma bhala inani lezingxenye.
m3d.tool.divide_move: {n} izingxenye: hambisa uye ngasemaphethelweni ukuze uthole ezinengi, uye ngasemaphakathini ukuze uthole ezimbalwa; chofoza ukuhlukanisa, noma bhala inani.
m3d.mesh.name: Imeshi
m3d.mesh.pick_a_group: Khetha iqembu noma ingxenye ukuze uyiguqule ibe imeshi.
m3d.mesh.busy: Imeshi iyahlelwa; zama futhi ukuhlela kuphele.
m3d.io.this_obj_file_could_not_be: Leli fayela le-OBJ alikwazanga ukufundwa njengombhalo.
m3d.io.this_obj_file_has_more_than: Leli fayela le-OBJ linamaphoyinti angaphezu kwezigidi ezi-2: likhulu kakhulu ukuze limodeliswe lapha.
m3d.io.this_obj_file_has_more_than_2: Leli fayela le-OBJ linezinhlangothi ezingaphezu kwezigidi ezi-2: likhulu kakhulu ukuze limodeliswe lapha.
m3d.io.this_gltf_file_is_too_big: Le fayela le-glTF likhulu kakhulu ukuze limodeliwe lapha (ngaphezu kwamavertex ayi-2 wezigidi).
m3d.io.a_buffer_view_runs_past_its: ukubuka kwebhafa kuchitheka ngaphezu kwebhafa lakho

shading.tp.why.no_material: Le nkombandlela ayinampahla yalelifayela. Qala ufake enye yezinto zalelifayela kuyo.
